Definition

Minimum climb performance required during a go-around or missed approach with all engines operating.

Operational example

Flight 321, execute missed approach, ensure landing climb gradient of at least 3.2 percent, contact Departure on 119.2.

Localized term

gradien pendakian saat mendarat

Localized example

Penerbangan 321, lakukan missed approach, pastikan gradien pendakian saat mendarat minimal 3.2 persen, hubungi Departure di 119.2.
